words.tr: n. 土著；（尤指澳大利亚的）土著居民
words.ex: The aborigine lived in the desert for thousands of years.
words.ex_cn: 这位土著在沙漠中生活了数千年。
words.en: An aborigine is one of the original or earliest known inhabitants of a country or region.

words.ex: His absence of interest made the teacher sad.
words.ex_cn: 他对学习的缺乏兴趣让老师感到难过。
words.en: The state of being away from a place or person.

words.tr:
adj. 学术的；
n. 大学教师；学者；
words.ex: He published an academic paper on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于气候变化的学术论文。
words.en: relating to education, especially at college or university level

words.ex: He speaks English with a French accent.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语时带有法国口音。
words.en: An accent is a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular country, area, or social class.

words.tr:
n. 账户；叙述；账目；
v. 占…；说明；
words.ex: I opened a bank account last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周开了一家银行账户。
words.en: An account is a detailed report or description of an event or situation.

words.tr: adj. 负有责任的；应作解释的
words.ex: He is accountable for his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他要为自己的错误负责。
words.en: If you are accountable to someone for something that you do, you are responsible for it and must be prepared to justify your actions to that person.

words.ex: The accuracy of the clock is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟的精确性很高。
words.en: The quality or state of being correct or precise.

words.ex: The clock shows accurate time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟显示的时间很精确。
words.en: Correct in all details; exact.

words.ex: He felt proud of his academic achievement.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的学业成就感到自豪。
words.en: An achievement is something which someone has succeeded in doing, especially after a lot of effort.

words.tr:
n. 酸；
adj. 酸性的；
words.ex: The acid in lemon juice tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁中的酸味道很酸。
words.en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

words.tr: v. 使激活； adj. 活性化的；有生气（activate 的过去分词）；
words.ex: The button activated the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 这个按钮激活了警报。
words.en: If a device or process is activated, it starts working.

words.ex: He is an actor in a famous movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是电影中的一名演员。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: The water supply is adequate for the village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对这个村庄来说是足够的。
words.en: If something is adequate, there is enough of it or it is good enough to be used or accepted.

words.ex: He used an adhesive to stick the paper on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏合剂把纸贴在墙上。
words.en: An adhesive is a substance used for sticking objects or materials together.

words.ex: The company will advertise its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司将在电视上为新手机登广告。
words.en: If you advertise something such as a product, an event, or a job, you tell people about it in newspapers, on television, or on posters in order to encourage them to buy the product, go to the event, or apply for the job.

words.ex: He saw an advertisement on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他在电视上看到一则广告。
words.en: An advertisement is a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event or publicizing a job vacancy.

words.tr: n. 广告活动；广告业； v. 做广告；“advertise”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company launched a new advertising campaign last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月推出了一项新的广告活动。
words.en: The activity of producing advertisements for commercial products or services.

words.ex: He wants to visit Africa next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年去非洲旅行。
words.en: Africa is the continent south of Europe, between the Atlantic Ocean and the Indian Ocean.

words.ex: We have lunch in the afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在下午吃午饭。
words.en: The part of the day from noon or lunchtime to evening.

words.tr:
n. 年龄；时代；
v. 变老；
words.ex: His age is 25 years.
words.ex_cn: 他的年龄是25岁。
words.en: The length of time that a person has lived or a thing has existed.

words.ex: The children are of different ages.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子的年龄不同。
words.en: Ages refers to a very long time or the period of history that is being referred to.

words.ex: The agency helps people find jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个机构帮助人们找工作。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.ex: Farmers work hard in agriculture.
words.ex_cn: 农民在农业中辛勤工作。
words.en: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.ex: He sees an airplane in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他看到天上有一架飞机。
words.en: An airplane is a vehicle with wings and one or more engines that enable it to fly through the air.

words.ex: We arrived at the airport early.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早到达了机场。
words.en: An airport is a place where aircraft regularly take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.ex: The Amazon River is in America.
words.ex_cn: 亚马逊河位于美洲。
words.en: The term 'America' can refer to the United States of America or the continents of North America and South America collectively.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.ex: The animal is sleeping in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只动物正在森林里睡觉。
words.en: An animal is a living creature such as a dog, lion, or rabbit, rather than a plant, insect, bird, or fish.

words.tr: adj. 一年一次的；每年的；
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
words.en: An annual event happens once every year.

words.ex: The doctor gave me antibiotics for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗生素来治疗感染。
words.en: Antibiotics are medicines that are used to treat infections caused by bacteria.

words.ex: He adds antifreeze to the car in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他在冬天给汽车加防冻液。
words.en: A substance added to a liquid to lower its freezing point, used especially in the radiator of a motor vehicle.

words.ex: He felt anxiety before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到忧虑。
words.en: Anxiety is a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome.

words.tr: n. 外观；外表；出现；露面；
words.ex: The appearance of the house surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The way that someone or something looks or the act of coming into view.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。
words.en: An appointment is a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time, especially for a purpose connected with their work or official position.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: The trip takes approximately 30 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这段旅程大约需要30分钟。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.

words.ex: She was born in April.
words.ex_cn: 她出生于四月。
words.en: The fourth month of the year, in the northern hemisphere usually considered the second month of spring.

words.ex: He is an architect who designs houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位设计房屋的建筑师。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.ex: The army trains new soldiers every month.
words.ex_cn: 军队每个月训练新兵。
words.en: An army is a large organized group of people who are armed and trained to fight on land in a war.

words.ex: The hunter shot an arrow at the target.
words.ex_cn: 猎人向目标射了一支箭。
words.en: An arrow is a long thin weapon which is sharp and pointed at one end and which often has feathers at the other end. Arrows are shot from a bow.

words.ex: He loves to paint and study art.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢绘画和学习艺术。
words.en: Art consists of paintings, sculpture, and other pictures or objects which are created for people to look at and admire or think deeply about.

words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.ex: He travels to Asia every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都去亚洲旅行。
words.en: Asia is the largest of the world's continents, covering approximately 30 percent of the Earth's land area. It is also the world's most populous continent, with roughly 60 percent of the total population.

words.ex: His aspiration is to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他的渴望是成为一名医生。
words.en: A strong desire to achieve something high or great.

words.tr: v. 对……进行评估（assess 过去时形式）
words.ex: The teacher assessed his homework yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 老师昨天批改了他的作业。
words.en: If you assess a person, thing, or situation, you consider them in order to make a judgment about them.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.ex: He asked for assistance with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他请求帮助做作业。
words.en: The act of helping or supporting someone or something.

words.ex: He joined a local book association.
words.ex_cn: 他加入了一个本地的图书协会。
words.en: An association is an official group of people who have the same job, aim, or interest.

words.ex: His assumption was that the train would be on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的假设是火车会准时。
words.en: An assumption is something that you assume to be the case, even without proof.

words.ex: The cost of the project is astronomic.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的成本极其高昂。
words.en: Astronomic refers to something that is related to astronomy or is extremely large in size or amount.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: He looked up the country in an atlas.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图册里查找那个国家。
words.en: An atlas is a book of maps or charts.

words.ex: The child needs attention when he does homework.
words.ex_cn: 孩子做作业时需要被关注。
words.en: Attention is the act of focusing your mind on something and taking notice of it.

words.ex: His attitude toward homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, which is often reflected in a person's behavior.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
words.en: The group of spectators at a public event; listeners or viewers collectively, especially those attending a performance or reading a particular work.

words.ex: He was born in August.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在八月。
words.en: August is the eighth month of the Gregorian calendar, following July and preceding September.

words.ex: My aunt bought me a birthday gift.
words.ex_cn: 我姨给我买了一份生日礼物。
words.en: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: He drives an automobile to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: A vehicle that is powered by an engine and is used for carrying passengers on roads.

words.ex: Leaves fall in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在秋季落下。
words.en: Autumn is the season between summer and winter when leaves change color and the weather becomes cooler.

words.ex: There are many shops on this avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这条大街上有许多商店。
words.en: An avenue is a wide street or main thoroughfare, often lined with trees or other landscaping.

words.ex: He picked up an axe to chop wood.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把斧子去砍柴。
words.en: An axe is a tool used for chopping wood, typically consisting of a heavy metal blade fixed at a right angle at the end of a long handle. As a verb, to axe means to dismiss or reduce something drastically.

words.ex: The baby is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: A baby is a very young child, especially one that cannot yet walk or talk.

words.ex: The babies are sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿们正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: Very young children, especially those who cannot yet walk or talk.

words.ex: He has a backache after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后背疼。
words.en: A backache is a pain in your back.

words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.ex: Bacteria can make you sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌会让你生病。
words.en: Bacteria are very small organisms. Some bacteria can cause diseases.

words.ex: She put the apples in a bag.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果装进了一个袋子里。
words.en: A bag is a container made of flexible material with an opening at the top, used for carrying things.

words.ex: I bought fresh bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 我从面包房买了新鲜面包。
words.en: A bakery is a place where bread, cakes, and pastries are made or sold.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.tr: n. 气球；热气球；玩具气球；球状物；
words.ex: The child held a red balloon at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在派对上拿着一个红色的气球。
words.en: A balloon is a small, thin, rubber bag that you blow air into so that it becomes larger and rounder or longer. Balloons are used as toys or decorations.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.ex: He scans the barcode with a small machine.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个小机器扫描条形码。
words.en: A bar code is a pattern of thick and thin black lines that is printed on things you buy. It contains information that a computer can read.

words.ex: He barely slept last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚几乎没睡觉。
words.en: You use barely to say that something is only just true or only just the case.

words.ex: I found a great bargain at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上找到了一件便宜货。
words.en: A bargain is an agreement between two people or groups in which each promises to do something in exchange for something else. It can also refer to something bought or offered for sale much more cheaply than is usual or expected.

words.ex: The police set up barriers on the road.
words.ex_cn: 警察在道路上设置了路障。
words.en: A barrier is a problem, rule, or situation that prevents someone from doing something, or that makes it difficult for them to do it.

words.ex: He plays baseball every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打棒球。
words.en: a game played especially in North America by two teams of nine players, in which a player hits a ball with a bat and tries to run around four bases on a large field before the other team returns the ball

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.ex: This is a basic math skill.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个基本的数学技能。
words.en: You use basic to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or necessary, and on which others depend.

words.ex: The basis of math is numbers.
words.ex_cn: 数学的基础是数字。
words.en: The underlying support or foundation for an idea, argument, or process.

words.ex: The bath is next to the bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 浴室在卧室旁边。
words.en: A bath is the process of washing your body, usually by sitting or lying in a container of water.

words.ex: I went to the bathroom after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭后我去了一趟浴室。
words.en: A room containing a bath or shower and typically also a washbasin and a toilet.

words.ex: The remote needs a new battery.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器需要新电池。
words.en: A battery is a device that produces electricity to provide power for radios, cars, toys, etc.

words.ex: The boat is parked in the bay.
words.ex_cn: 船停在海湾里。
words.en: A bay is a body of water partially enclosed by land, typically smaller than a gulf. It can also refer to a compartment for a ship, the color of a horse, or the sound a dog makes.

words.ex: We walked on the beach at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 我们在日落时漫步在海滩上。
words.en: A beach is a landform along the coast of an ocean, sea, lake, or river. It usually consists of loose particles, which are often composed of rock, such as sand, gravel, shingle, pebbles, or cobblestones.

words.ex: We walked on the beaches at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 我们在日落时漫步在海滩上。
words.en: A beach is a landform alongside a body of water which consists of loose particles. The particles composing a beach are typically made from rock, such as sand, gravel, shingle, pebbles, or cobblestones.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.ex: He lives in a bedsit near the station.
words.ex_cn: 他住在车站附近的一间单间公寓里。
words.en: A bedsit is a single room that serves as both bedroom and living room, often with basic cooking facilities.

words.ex: The bee is flying near the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂正在花附近飞舞。
words.en: A bee is a flying insect known for its role in pollination and for producing honey and beeswax.

words.ex: Bees are flying around the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在花周围飞舞。
words.en: Bees are flying insects closely related to wasps and ants, known for their role in pollination and, in the case of the best-known bee species, the western honey bee, for producing honey and beeswax.

words.ex: He drinks beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝啤酒。
words.en: Beer is an alcoholic drink made from grain.

words.ex: He is a beginner in piano lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他是钢琴课的初学者。
words.en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and has not yet mastered it.

words.ex: His behaviour at school is very good.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校的行为很好。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.ex: The factory uses a belt to move boxes.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用传送带来运送箱子。
words.en: A belt is a strip of leather or other material worn around the waist to support clothes or for decoration.

words.ex: He rides his bicycle to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑自行车去上学。
words.en: A bicycle is a vehicle with two wheels which you ride by sitting on it and pushing two pedals with your feet.

words.tr: adj. 两种语言的；用两种语言的；
words.ex: He is a bilingual student who speaks English and Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个会说英语和西班牙语的双语学生。
words.en: A bilingual person is someone who can speak two languages equally well.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.ex: He pays his bills every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五支付账单。
words.en: A bill is a written statement of money that you owe for goods or services.

words.ex: There are a billion stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有十亿颗星星。
words.en: A billion is a thousand million, or 1,000,000,000.

words.ex: The bird flies over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟飞过树。
words.en: A bird is a creature with feathers and wings. Female birds lay eggs, and most birds can fly.

words.ex: The coffee had a strong bitterness.
words.ex_cn: 这杯咖啡有很重的苦味。
words.en: Bitterness is the quality of having a sharp, pungent taste or of feeling angry and unhappy because of bad experiences.

words.tr: v. （使）漂白；（使）晒白；（使）变成淡色；
words.ex: The sun is bleaching the clothes on the line.
words.ex_cn: 阳光正在使晾衣绳上的衣服变白。
words.en: The process of making something white or lighter in color by using chemicals or sunlight.

words.ex: The blind man walks with a white cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位失明的男人用白色手杖走路。
words.en: Unable to see; lacking the sense of sight.

words.ex: He writes a blog about travel.
words.ex_cn: 他写一个关于旅行的博客。
words.en: A blog is a website containing a writer's or group of writers' own experiences, observations, opinions, etc., and often having images and links to other websites.

words.ex: The blond man smiled at the children.
words.ex_cn: 那个白肤金发的男子对孩子们微笑了。
words.en: If someone has blond hair, it is pale yellow in color.

words.tr:
adj. 蓝色的；
n. 蓝色；
words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: Blue is a color that is between green and violet in the spectrum of visible light. It is also used to describe something that is sad or depressed.

words.ex: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 狗把一根骨头埋在了花园里。
words.en: The hard, rigid form of connective tissue constituting most of the skeleton of vertebrates, composed chiefly of calcium salts.

words.tr: n. 奖金；红利；额外津贴；
words.ex: He received a bonus for working overtime.
words.ex_cn: 他因加班获得了奖金。
words.en: A bonus is an extra amount of money that is added to someone's pay, usually because they have worked very hard.

words.tr: n. 预订； v. 预订；“book”的现在分词；
words.ex: I made a booking for a hotel room.
words.ex_cn: 我预订了一间酒店房间。
words.en: The act of reserving accommodations, travel arrangements, tickets, etc., in advance.

words.ex: He put his books on the bookshelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在书架上。
words.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for storing books.

words.ex: He buys a novel at the bookshop.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A shop where books are sold.

words.ex: He bought a novel at the bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A bookstore is a shop where books are sold.

words.ex: He put the suitcase in the boot of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李箱放进了汽车的后备箱里。
words.en: A boot is a type of shoe that covers the whole foot and the lower part of the leg. It can also mean to kick something forcefully or to start a computer.

words.ex: He wore heavy boots to walk in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了厚重的靴子在雪地里走路。
words.en: Boots are a type of footwear that covers the foot and extends up the leg, sometimes to the knee or even the hip. They are typically made of leather or rubber and are worn for protection against cold, wet, or rugged terrain.

words.ex: He bought a hot dog from a food booth.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个小吃亭买了个热狗。
words.en: A booth is a small area separated from a larger public area by screens or thin walls where, for example, people can make a phone call or vote in private.

words.ex: He drank water from a bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个瓶子里喝水。
words.en: A bottle is a glass or plastic container in which drinks and other liquids are kept. Bottles are usually round with straight sides and a narrow top.

words.ex: He put the books in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放进了一个箱子里。
words.en: A box is a container with a flat base and sides, typically square or rectangular and having a lid.

words.ex: The brain controls our thoughts and movements.
words.ex_cn: 大脑控制我们的思想和行动。
words.en: The brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

words.ex: The tree has many branches.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树有许多分支。
words.en: A branch of a tree is one of its parts that grows out from its trunk. A branch of a business or organization is one of its offices or shops that are in different places.

words.tr:
v. 打破；打断；
n. 休息；中断；破裂；
words.ex: He broke the glass by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打破了玻璃。
words.en: If you break something, you cause it to separate into two or more pieces, often in a way that is irreparable.

words.tr: n. 呼吸； v. 呼吸；“breathe”的现在分词；
words.ex: Deep breathing helps you relax.
words.ex_cn: 深呼吸有助于你放松。
words.en: The process of taking air into the lungs and expelling it; a sign of life.

words.tr: n. 繁殖；饲养； v. “breed”的现在分词；
words.ex: The farm focuses on cattle breeding.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场专注于牛的繁殖。
words.en: The process of producing animals or plants by sexual reproduction, or the process of raising animals or plants in controlled conditions.

words.ex: The bridge crosses the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥横跨河流。
words.en: A bridge is a structure that is built over a railway, river, or road so that people or vehicles can cross from one side to the other.

words.tr: n. 夫或妻的兄弟；姐夫；妹夫；连襟；姻兄弟
words.ex: My brother-in-law works at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 我的姐夫/妹夫在医院工作。
words.en: The brother of your husband or wife, or the man who is married to your sister.

words.ex: The child blew a bubble with gum.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用口香糖吹了一个气泡。
words.en: A bubble is a small ball of air or gas in a liquid, or a ball of air inside a solid substance such as glass.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.ex: We had dinner at a buffet with many dishes to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 我们在自助餐吃了晚饭，有很多菜可以选。
words.en: A buffet is a meal consisting of several dishes from which guests serve themselves. As a verb, to buffet means to strike repeatedly and violently.

words.tr: n. 建筑物；楼房； v. 建筑；“build”的现在分词；
words.ex: The tall building has 20 floors.
words.ex_cn: 这栋高楼有20层。
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.tr: v. 建筑；建造；“build”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They built a house last year.
words.ex_cn: 他们去年建了一栋房子。
words.en: The past tense and past participle of 'build', meaning to construct something by putting parts or material together.

words.ex: He is bullying his little brother.
words.ex_cn: 他正在欺负他的弟弟。
words.en: The use of strength or influence to harm or intimidate those who are weaker.

words.tr: v. 埋葬；埋藏；“bury”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 埋在地下的；
words.ex: They buried the dog in the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把狗埋在了后院里。
words.en: If something is buried, it is placed in a hole in the ground and covered with earth, or it is hidden or concealed in some way.

words.ex: He runs a small business selling bread.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家卖面包的小生意。
words.en: Business refers to the activity of buying and selling goods and services, or a particular company that does this.

words.ex: She spread butter on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上抹了黄油。
words.en: Butter is a pale yellow edible fatty substance made by churning cream and used as a spread or in cooking.

words.ex: A butterfly is flying over the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝴蝶在花上飞舞。
words.en: A butterfly is an insect with large, often brightly coloured wings.

words.ex: The children saw butterflies in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在花园里看到了蝴蝶。
words.en: Butterflies are insects with large, often brightly coloured wings, which they use to fly.

words.ex: She sewed a button on her coat.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗纽扣缝在了外套上。
words.en: A button is a small, usually round object that you press to operate a device or a machine, or a small, round object that you fasten to clothing to keep it closed.

words.ex: I took a cab to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我打了一辆出租车去机场。
words.en: A cab is a taxi, a vehicle that carries passengers for a fare, usually calculated by a meter.

words.ex: The sailors slept in the cabin during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 水手们在风暴期间睡在船舱里。
words.en: A cabin is a small room or compartment, especially one on a ship or an aircraft.

words.ex: The family stayed in wooden cabins near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这家人住在湖边的小木屋里。
words.en: Small, simple houses or rooms, especially those made of wood and located in a rural or wild area.

words.ex: He kept the dishes in the cabinet.
words.ex_cn: 他把盘子放在储藏柜里。
words.en: A cabinet is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves or drawers, used for storing or showing things. In politics, a cabinet is a group of people who are chosen by a head of state to give advice and to help set government policy.

words.ex: The cable connects the computer to the printer.
words.ex_cn: 这条电缆将电脑连接到打印机。
words.en: A cable is a thick wire or rope, or a bundle of wires or ropes, used to carry electricity or electronic signals, or to support a structure.

words.ex: He drinks coffee at a small cafe.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小咖啡馆喝咖啡。
words.en: A cafe is a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold.

words.ex: He calculates the total cost quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速计算出总成本。
words.en: To determine by mathematical methods; compute.

words.ex: He uses a calculator to add numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算器来加数字。
words.en: A calculator is a small electronic device that you use for doing mathematical calculations.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.tr: n. 卡路里（热量单位）；“calorie”的复数；
words.ex: This apple has about 95 calories.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果大约有95卡路里。
words.en: A calorie is a unit of energy. In nutrition, calories refer to the energy people get from the food and drink they consume, and the energy they use in physical activity.

words.ex: He took a photo with his camera.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的摄像机拍了一张照片。
words.en: A camera is a piece of equipment that is used for taking photographs, making films, or producing television pictures.

words.tr:
n. 营地；
v. 宿营；露营；
words.ex: The children set up a camp near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖边搭了一个营地。
words.en: A camp is a place where people live temporarily in tents or other temporary structures.

words.ex: We set up our tent at the campsite near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 我们在湖边的野营地搭了帐篷。
words.en: A campsite is a place where people who are camping can stay, often with facilities such as toilets and showers.

words.ex: He bought a Canadian maple syrup.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一瓶加拿大的枫糖浆。
words.en: Of or relating to Canada or its people, culture, or language.

words.ex: The boat travels through the canal.
words.ex_cn: 船通过运河航行。
words.en: A canal is a long, narrow stretch of water that has been made for boats to travel along or to bring water to a particular area.

words.ex: He buys lunch in the school canteen.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校食堂买午餐。
words.en: A canteen is a place in a factory, office, or school where meals are served, often at a lower cost than in restaurants. It can also refer to a small container for carrying water or other drinks.

words.tr:
n. 首都；财富；大写字母；
adj. 大写的；
words.ex: Beijing is the capital of China.
words.ex_cn: 北京是中国的首都。
words.en: The city or town that functions as the seat of government and administrative center of a country or region.

words.ex: He believes in capitalism and owns a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他相信资本主义，并拥有一家小企业。
words.en: Capitalism is an economic system in which the means of production are privately owned and operated for profit in a competitive market.

words.ex: He drives a red car to work.
words.ex_cn: 他开车去上班。
words.en: A car is a motor vehicle with four wheels, usually propelled by an internal combustion engine.

words.ex: He parked his car in the car park.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了停车场。
words.en: A car park is an area or building where people can leave their cars.

words.ex: Carbon is an element in all living things.
words.ex_cn: 碳是所有生物体中的一种元素。
words.en: Carbon is a chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6. It is nonmetallic and tetravalent—making four electrons available to form covalent chemical bonds.

words.ex: We went to the carnival last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了嘉年华。
words.en: A carnival is a public festival, typically one held annually in a particular place, involving processions, music, and dancing.

words.ex: The lion is a carnivorous animal.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种食肉动物。
words.en: Carnivorous animals or plants eat meat.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.ex: My brother watches cartoon every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天晚上看卡通片。
words.en: A cartoon is a humorous drawing or series of drawings in a newspaper or magazine, or a film made using animation techniques.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.tr:
n. 出纳员，收银员
v. 革除（军职）
words.ex: The cashier counted the money at the end of the day.
words.ex_cn: 收银员在一天结束时清点了钱。
words.en: A cashier is a person whose job is to receive and pay out money in a shop, bank, or business.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.ex: He looked at the catalogue to find the book.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看目录来找那本书。
words.en: A catalogue is a list of things such as the goods you can buy from a particular company, the objects in a museum, or the books in a library.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.tr: v. 满足需要；“cater”的现在分词； n. 包办饮食；
words.ex: The new service is catering to the needs of students.
words.ex_cn: 这项新服务正在满足学生的需求。
words.en: The business of providing food and drink for events or occasions.

words.ex: The cathedral has tall towers and stained glass windows.
words.ex_cn: 这座大教堂有高高的塔楼和彩绘玻璃窗。
words.en: A cathedral is a very large and important church which has a bishop in charge of it.

words.ex: The farmer feeds his cattle every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂他的牛。
words.en: Cattle are large domesticated animals that are kept on farms for their milk or meat.

words.ex: The boy found a dark cave near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在山附近发现了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cave is a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or one that is under the ground.

words.tr: abbr. 激光唱片；光盘；“Compact Disc”的缩写
words.ex: I bought a cd of my favorite songs.
words.ex_cn: 我买了一张我最爱歌曲的激光唱片。
words.en: A chemical element (symbol Cd) that is a soft, bluish-white metal, often used in batteries and pigments, and is toxic.

words.ex: They used cement to build the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他们用水泥建造了这堵墙。
words.en: Cement is a powdery substance which is mixed with water and used for sticking things together or for making very hard surfaces.

words.ex: The central park is in the middle of the city.
words.ex_cn: 中央公园位于城市中心。
words.en: Something that is central is of key or fundamental importance.

words.ex: The teacher writes on the board with chalk.
words.ex_cn: 老师用粉笔在黑板上写字。
words.en: A soft white limestone (calcium carbonate) formed from the skeletal remains of sea creatures.

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.tr: n. 清单；检查表；备忘录；目录册；
words.ex: He made a checklist for his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为旅行列了一份清单。
words.en: A checklist is a list of items required, things to be done, or points to be considered, used as a reminder.

words.ex: He eats cheese every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃奶酪。
words.en: Cheese is a food made from the pressed curds of milk, often with added flavorings and sometimes with a hard or soft texture.

words.tr:
adj. 化学的；
n. 化学品；
words.ex: The lab has a chemical reaction.
words.ex_cn: 实验室里有一个化学反应。
words.en: A chemical is a substance that is used in or produced by a process involving chemistry.

words.ex: The factory releases chemicals into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂将化学药品排入河中。
words.en: Chemicals are substances that are used in or produced by a chemical process.

words.ex: The chemist discovered a new element.
words.ex_cn: 这位化学家发现了一种新元素。
words.en: A chemist is a scientist who specializes in chemistry, or in some contexts, a person who is qualified to prepare and dispense drugs and medicines.

words.ex: He likes chemistry because it is fun.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢化学，因为它很有趣。
words.en: Chemistry is the scientific study of the structure of substances and how they react with each other.

words.ex: He paid with a cheque yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天用支票付款了。
words.en: A written order to a bank to pay a specified sum from someone's account.

words.ex: The children are playing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。
words.en: Children are people who are not yet adults, typically those who are under the age of 18.

words.ex: She bought a beautiful china cup at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了一个漂亮的瓷杯。
words.en: China is a country in East Asia, the world's most populous country, with a population of over 1.4 billion. It is also known for its rich history, culture, and contributions to the world, including the invention of paper, printing, the compass, and gunpowder.

words.tr:
adj. 中国的；
n. 中国人；汉语；
words.ex: She ate Chinese food for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚饭吃了中国菜。
words.en: Of or relating to China, its people, or their languages.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.ex: He made a choice to study hard.
words.ex_cn: 他选择努力学习。
words.en: If you have a choice, you can choose between two or more things.

words.ex: He has many choices for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐有很多选择。
words.en: Choices are the different things that you can choose from or the act of choosing between them.

words.ex: He chooses coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都选择喝咖啡。
words.en: To choose means to select someone or something from a group of possibilities.

words.ex: We buy gifts for Christmas.
words.ex_cn: 我们为圣诞节买礼物。
words.en: Christmas is the period around the 25th of December when Christians celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ.

words.ex: He goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日去教堂。
words.en: A church is a building where Christians go to worship.

words.ex: He smokes a cigar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后抽一支雪茄。
words.en: A cigar is a tightly rolled bundle of dried and fermented tobacco leaves, which is ignited so that its smoke may be drawn into the mouth.

words.ex: We went to the cinema last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去看了电影。
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films. It can also refer to the art and industry of making films.

words.ex: He plays the clarinet in the school band.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校乐队里吹单簧管。
words.en: A clarinet is a musical instrument of the woodwind family in the shape of a pipe. You play the clarinet by blowing into it and covering and uncovering the holes with your fingers.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical refers to music, literature, or art that is considered to be of the highest quality and of lasting value, especially from the ancient Greek or Roman periods or from the 18th and early 19th centuries.

words.ex: The teacher gave a classification of animals into mammals and birds.
words.ex_cn: 老师将动物分为哺乳动物和鸟类。
words.en: The action or process of classifying something according to shared qualities or characteristics.

words.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把黏土塑造成一个碗。
words.en: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material that contains hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates (clay minerals) that develops plasticity when wet.

words.tr: n. 清洁工人；清洁工具； adj. 更洁净的；更干净的；“clean”的比较级；
words.ex: The cleaner sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 清洁工人每天早上扫地。
words.en: A cleaner is a person whose job is to clean a place or a substance used for cleaning.

words.ex: The hiker stood at the edge of the cliff.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者站在悬崖边上。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river.

words.ex: The birds nest on the high cliffs.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在高高的悬崖上筑巢。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of land with a very steep side, especially one next to the sea.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.tr: adj. 关闭的；保密的； v. 关闭；“close”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The store is closed on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店星期天关门。
words.en: If something is closed, it is not open or available to the public.

words.ex: She bought some cloth to make a dress.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一些布来做裙子。
words.en: Cloth is fabric which is made by weaving or knitting cotton, wool, silk, or other threads. Cloth is used especially for making clothes.

words.ex: He hangs his clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服挂在绳子上晾干。
words.en: Clothes are the things that people wear, such as shirts, coats, trousers, and dresses.

words.ex: He bought new clothing for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他为冬天买了新衣服。
words.en: Clothing refers to items worn on the body. Clothing is typically made of fabrics or textiles but over time has included garments made from animal skin or other thin sheets of materials put together.

words.ex: The cloud floats high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 云朵在天空中飘浮。
words.en: A cloud is a visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere, typically high above the ground.

words.ex: The water in the pond is cloudy.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里的水很浑浊。
words.en: If it is cloudy, there are a lot of clouds in the sky.

words.ex: He joins a chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick used as a weapon or for hitting a ball in sports.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: He burns coal to keep his house warm.
words.ex_cn: 他烧煤来让房子暖和。
words.en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.

words.ex: We walked along the coast and saw the sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着海岸散步，看到了大海。
words.en: The coast is the land along the edge of the sea or ocean.

words.ex: The coastal village has beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 这个沿海村庄有美丽的海滩。
words.en: relating to the coast, the area where the land meets the sea

words.tr: n. 代码；编码；行为准则；密码；法典；
words.ex: He wrote a simple code to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段简单的代码来解决这个数学问题。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy. As a verb, it means to convert (a message or other information) into a code.

words.ex: He drinks coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝咖啡。
words.en: Coffee is a hot drink made from the roasted and ground seeds of a tropical shrub.

words.tr:
n. 硬币；金属钱币；
v. 创造；
words.ex: He has a coin in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有一枚硬币。
words.en: A coin is a small, flat, round piece of metal or plastic that is used as money.

words.ex: He enjoys collecting stamps.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢收集邮票。
words.en: The act of gathering items together, especially as a hobby or for study.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.tr: n. 群体；殖民地；聚居地；
words.ex: A colony of ants moved quickly across the ground.
words.ex_cn: 一群蚂蚁迅速从地上爬过。
words.en: A colony is a country or area that is under the political control of another country, usually one that is far away, and where people from that country live.

words.tr:
n. 颜色；
v. 着色；
words.ex: The sky has a blue colour.
words.ex_cn: 天空有一种蓝色。
words.en: Colour is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light. Red, blue, and green are colours.

words.tr: adj. 带…色的；有色的； v. “color”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The sky turned coloured with orange and pink at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出橙色和粉色。
words.en: Coloured is used to describe something that has color or is not black and white.

words.ex: He likes to watch comedy on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看喜剧。
words.en: A comedy is a type of drama or other art form the main object of which, according to modern notions, is to amuse.

words.ex: The comet shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 彗星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A comet is a celestial object consisting of a nucleus of ice and dust and, when near the sun, a 'tail' of gas and dust particles pointing away from the sun.

words.ex: Comets fly through space and have long tails.
words.ex_cn: 彗星在太空中飞行，有长长的尾巴。
words.en: A comet is a celestial object consisting of a nucleus of ice and dust and, when near the sun, a 'tail' of gas and dust particles pointing away from the sun.

words.ex: This chair is very comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子非常舒适。
words.en: If a piece of furniture or an item of clothing is comfortable, it makes you feel physically relaxed when you use it or wear it, for example because it is soft.

words.tr:
adj. 贸易的；商业的；
n. 广告；
words.ex: The commercial ship sailed to another country.
words.ex_cn: 这艘贸易船只驶向了另一个国家。
words.en: Commercial relates to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.ex: Good communication helps people understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 良好的交流有助于人们相互理解。
words.en: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.

words.ex: This is a comparative study of two languages.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个关于两种语言的比较研究。
words.en: You use comparative to show that you are judging something against a previous or different situation. For example, if you say that something is comparative luxury, you mean that it is luxurious compared to something else.

words.ex: This room is comparatively small.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间相对较小。
words.en: In comparison with something else, especially something similar; relatively.

words.ex: The comparison of the two phones helped me decide.
words.ex_cn: 对这两部手机的比较帮助我做出了决定。
words.en: When you make a comparison, you consider two or more things and discover the differences or similarities between them.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.ex: The completion of the project took three months.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的完成花了三个月。
words.en: The act of finishing or making something whole or perfect.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: The math problem is complicated.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题很复杂。
words.en: Involving many different and confusing aspects.

words.ex: The teacher explained the topic comprehensively.
words.ex_cn: 老师全面地讲解了这个主题。
words.en: In a way that includes or deals with all or nearly all elements or aspects of something.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.tr: v. 集中；浓缩；“concentrate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 浓缩的；密集的；全神贯注的；
words.ex: He concentrated on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他专心做作业。
words.en: If something is concentrated, it has been made stronger or purer by removing or reducing the amount of other substances in it.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.tr:
n. 混凝土；
adj. 具体的；
words.ex: The workers poured concrete to build the foundation.
words.ex_cn: 工人们浇筑混凝土来建造地基。
words.en: Concrete is a hard, strong construction material made by mixing a cementing material (such as Portland cement) and a mineral aggregate (such as sand and gravel) with sufficient water to cause the cement to set and bind the entire mass. In a broader sense, concrete can also refer to something that is tangible, specific, or real.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: He spoke with confidence during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲时充满信心。
words.en: Confidence is a feeling of self-assurance arising from one's appreciation of one's own abilities or qualities.

words.ex: He is confident when he speaks in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时很自信。
words.en: If you are confident, you are certain of your abilities or of your beliefs.

words.ex: He looked at me with confusion.
words.ex_cn: 他困惑地看着我。
words.en: A state of uncertainty about what is happening, intended, or required.

words.tr: n. 保护；节约（自然资源）；
words.ex: The park is for the conservation of wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是为了保护野生动物。
words.en: The protection and preservation of the natural environment and wildlife.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.ex: The consumption of water has increased this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年水的消耗量增加了。
words.en: Consumption is the act of buying and using products.

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.ex: The river is contaminated by factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 这条河被工厂废料污染了。
words.en: To contaminate something means to make it impure or polluted by contact or mixture with something unclean or harmful.

words.tr: v. 污染；弄脏；“contaminate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The river was contaminated by factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 河流被工厂废料污染了。
words.en: If something is contaminated, it has been made dirty or harmful, usually by the addition of something, especially chemicals or radiation.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.ex: She turned on the cooker to boil water.
words.ex_cn: 她打开炉子烧水。
words.en: A cooker is a device or appliance used for cooking food.

words.ex: He ate popcorn made from corn.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用玉米做的爆米花。
words.en: Corn is a tall plant which produces long vegetables covered with yellow seeds. It is also a cereal crop.

words.ex: He made a correction to his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他改正了他的答案。
words.en: A correction is a change that makes something right, accurate, or better.

words.ex: The teacher gave me the corrections for my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我作文的修改意见。
words.en: Changes that are made to something in order to correct or improve it.

words.ex: She uses cosmetic cream to make her skin look better.
words.ex_cn: 她使用美容霜让皮肤看起来更好。
words.en: A cosmetic is a substance that you put on your face or body to improve its appearance.

words.tr: n. 化妆品；美容品；“cosmetic”的复数；
words.ex: She buys cosmetics at the drugstore.
words.ex_cn: 她在药店买化妆品。
words.en: Substances or treatments used to enhance or alter the appearance of the face or body.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.tr: n. 成本；费用；“cost”的复数； v. 花费；
words.ex: The costs of buying a new car are high.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车的成本很高。
words.en: Costs refer to the amount of money that is required to purchase, produce, or maintain something, or the effort, loss, or sacrifice necessary to achieve or obtain something.

words.ex: The new phone is too costly for me.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机对我来说太贵了。
words.en: If you say that something is costly, you mean that it costs a lot of money, often more than you would want to pay.

words.ex: They live in a small cottage near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小村舍里。
words.en: A cottage is a small house, usually in the countryside.

words.tr:
v. 计算；看作；清点；
n. 计数；计算；
words.ex: He counts the apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他计算桌子上的苹果数量。
words.en: To determine the total number of a collection of items.

words.ex: He loves his country and wants to serve it.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱自己的国家，想要为它服务。
words.en: A country is a region identified as a distinct entity in political geography.

words.tr:
n. 裂缝；噼啪声；
v. 破裂；
words.ex: There is a small crack in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一条小裂缝。
words.en: If something hard cracks, or if you crack it, it becomes slightly damaged, with lines appearing on its surface.

words.ex: The craftsman made a wooden chair by hand.
words.ex_cn: 这位工匠手工制作了一把木椅。
words.en: A craftsman is a skilled worker who makes things by hand.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；皱痕
v. 起皱；弄皱
words.ex: The paper has a deep crease from folding.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸因为折叠而有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: A crease is a line or mark made on cloth or paper when it is folded or crushed.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful creation of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是艺术家的一个美丽作品。
words.en: The act or process of bringing something into existence.

words.ex: His creativeness helps him solve problems in new ways.
words.ex_cn: 他的创造力帮助他以新的方式解决问题。
words.en: The ability to use the imagination to develop new and original ideas or things, especially in an artistic context.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.ex: The creature lived in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这个生物生活在森林里。
words.en: A creature is a living thing, especially an animal.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.ex: The country is facing an economic crisis.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正面临经济危机。
words.en: A crisis is a situation in which something or someone is affected by one or more very serious problems.

words.ex: He often criticizes his brother for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他经常批评他弟弟迟到。
words.en: If you criticize someone or something, you express your disapproval of them by saying what you think is wrong with them.

words.ex: The crocodile is swimming in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鳄鱼正在河里游泳。
words.en: A crocodile is a large reptile that lives in rivers in the tropical regions of Africa, Asia, America, and Australia. It has a long body, a long tail, and very strong jaws.

words.ex: A crow sat on the tree branch.
words.ex_cn: 一只乌鸦坐在树枝上。
words.en: A crow is a large black bird which makes a loud, harsh noise. If someone crows, they talk in a very proud way about something they have done or achieved.

words.ex: A large crowd gathered at the square.
words.ex_cn: 一大群人聚集在广场上。
words.en: A crowd is a large group of people who have gathered together, for example, to watch or listen to something interesting, or to protest about something.

words.ex: The baby is crying for milk.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在哭着要奶。
words.en: The act of shedding tears, often as an expression of distress, pain, or sorrow.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.ex: She put the plates in the cupboard.
words.ex_cn: 她把盘子放在碗橱里。
words.en: A cupboard is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves that is used for storing things, usually in a kitchen.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.ex: The school changed its curricula last year.
words.ex_cn: 学校去年更改了课程。
words.en: Curricula are the subjects that are taught by a school, college, or university, or the things that are studied in a particular subject.

words.ex: She pulled the curtain to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上帷幕以挡住阳光。
words.en: A curtain is a piece of material that hangs down, often used to cover a window or to divide a room.

words.ex: She pulled the curtains to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上窗帘以挡住阳光。
words.en: Curtains are pieces of material that hang from the top of a window and can be drawn across it to cover it.

words.tr: adj. 呈弯曲状的；弧形的； v. （使）弯成弧形；“curve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The road is curved around the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这条路沿着山呈弯曲状。
words.en: Having the shape of a curve; not straight.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.tr: n. 骑自行车； v. 骑自行车；“cycle”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cycling is good for health.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车对健康有益。
words.en: Cycling is the activity of riding a bicycle, especially as a sport or for pleasure.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.ex: The ground is damp after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是潮湿的。
words.en: Something that is damp is slightly wet, often in a way that is unpleasant.

words.tr:
n. 舞蹈；
v. 跳舞；
words.ex: She loves to watch the traditional dance.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢观看传统舞蹈。
words.en: To move your body rhythmically to music, typically following a set sequence of steps.

words.tr: n. 跳舞；舞蹈； v. 跳舞；“dance”的现在分词；
words.ex: Dancing is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 跳舞是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: the activity of moving your body in time to music

words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.tr:
adj. 黑暗的；暗色的；深色的；
n. 黑暗；夜；暗色；
words.ex: The room was dark after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后，房间变得黑暗。
words.en: The absence of light in a place is referred to as dark. It can also describe something that is not light in color, or something that is mysterious or difficult to understand.

words.ex: The school stores student records in a database.
words.ex_cn: 学校将学生记录存储在数据库中。
words.en: A database is a collection of data that is organized so that it can easily be accessed, managed, and updated.

words.ex: He lived in Paris for a decade.
words.ex_cn: 他在巴黎生活了十年。
words.en: A decade is a period of ten years, especially one that begins with a year ending in 0, for example 1980 to 1989.

words.ex: My birthday is in December.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在十二月。
words.en: December is the twelfth and last month of the year in the Julian and Gregorian calendars and the seventh and last of seven months to have a length of 31 days.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.tr: v. 下降；衰退；“decline”的现在分词； adj. 衰退的；下滑的；
words.ex: The number of students is declining each year.
words.ex_cn: 学生人数每年都在下降。
words.en: If something is declining, it is becoming less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.ex: She bought new decoration for her living room.
words.ex_cn: 她为客厅买了新的装饰品。
words.en: Decoration is the process or art of decorating something, or the objects used to decorate something.

words.tr: n. 装饰品；装饰物；“decoration”的复数；
words.ex: The Christmas tree has many colorful decorations.
words.ex_cn: 圣诞树上有许多五彩缤纷的装饰品。
words.en: Objects or materials used to make a place look more attractive, especially something used for a special occasion or celebration.

words.tr:
n. 减少；
v. 减少；降低；
words.ex: There was a decrease in rainfall last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月降雨量减少了。
words.en: If something decreases or you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.ex: The team improved its defense in the second half.
words.ex_cn: 球队在下半场改进了防守。
words.en: The act of defending against attack, danger, or injury.

words.tr:
n. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
v. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
words.ex: The flight had a delay because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 由于风暴，航班推迟了。
words.en: If you delay doing something, you do not do it immediately or at the planned or expected time, but you leave it until later.

words.ex: The delivery of the package took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹的交付花了三天时间。
words.en: The act of delivering letters, parcels, or goods.

words.ex: The deliveries arrive every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这些送货每天早上都到。
words.en: The act of bringing or transporting something to a place.

words.tr:
n. 需求；要求；
v. 要求；需求；
words.ex: The demand for clean water is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: If you demand something, you ask for it very forcefully, often because you think you have a right to do so.

words.ex: He votes in a democratic election.
words.ex_cn: 他在民主选举中投票。
words.en: A democratic country, government, or political system is governed by representatives who are elected by the people.

words.ex: The density of water is 1 gram per cubic centimeter.
words.ex_cn: 水的密度是每立方厘米1克。
words.en: Density is a measure of how much mass is contained in a given unit volume of a substance.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.ex: The teacher gave a clear description of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师对实验做了清晰的描述。
words.en: A description of someone or something is a statement that explains what they are or what they are like.

words.ex: The camel walks across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼穿越沙漠。
words.en: A desert is a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand. If you desert someone or something, you leave them and no longer help or support them.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.tr: n. 毁灭；引起毁灭的根源；
words.ex: The storm caused the destruction of the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴摧毁了村庄。
words.en: The act of destroying something, or the state of being destroyed.

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.ex: The diameter of the circle is 10 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的直径是10厘米。
words.en: A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere.

words.ex: He writes in his diary every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都写日记。
words.en: A diary is a book in which you write down your personal experiences and thoughts each day.

words.ex: I looked up the word in a dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在词典里查了这个词。
words.en: A dictionary is a book in which the words of a language are listed alphabetically, together with their meanings, pronunciations, and other information.

words.tr:
n. 日常饮食；节食；
v. 节制饮食；
words.ex: His diet includes lots of vegetables and fruits.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常饮食包括大量蔬菜和水果。
words.en: The food and drink usually consumed by a person or group; a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.ex: Good digestion helps your body absorb nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 良好的消化有助于身体吸收营养。
words.en: The process by which food is broken down in the stomach and intestines so that the body can absorb it and use it for energy and nutrients.

words.ex: The digestive system breaks down food.
words.ex_cn: 消化系统分解食物。
words.en: Relating to the process of digesting food.

words.ex: We have dinner at 7 p.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天晚上7点吃晚餐。
words.en: The main meal of the day, eaten in the evening or at midday.

words.ex: Carbon dioxide makes the air warm.
words.ex_cn: 二氧化碳使空气变暖。
words.en: A compound containing two atoms of oxygen combined with another element or group.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他问了去车站的方向。
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

words.tr: adj. 残疾的； v. “disable”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The disabled man uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 这位残疾人使用轮椅行动。
words.en: If someone is disabled, they are unable to use part of their body or mind properly, for example, because of injury or illness.

words.ex: The doctor treated his disease with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生用药物治疗了他的疾病。
words.en: A disease is an illness that affects people, animals, or plants, often caused by infection or a failure of health rather than by an accident.

words.ex: Many diseases can be prevented with clean water.
words.ex_cn: 许多疾病可以通过干净的水来预防。
words.en: A disease is an illness which affects people, animals, or plants, for example one which is caused by bacteria or infection.

words.ex: The disposal of waste is important for the environment.
words.ex_cn: 废物的处理对环境很重要。
words.en: The act or process of getting rid of something, especially by throwing it away or selling it.

words.ex: The distance between the two towns is 10 kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 两个城镇之间的距离是10公里。
words.en: The amount of space between two places or things.

words.tr: n. 扭曲；歪曲；失真；畸变；
words.ex: The photo showed distortion in the lines.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中的线条出现了扭曲。
words.en: A distortion is a change, twist, or exaggeration that makes something appear different from the way it really is.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.tr: adj. 引起烦恼的；令人不安的； v. 打扰；妨碍；“disturb”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie showed a disturbing scene of violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了一个引起烦恼的暴力场景。
words.en: If you describe something as disturbing, you mean that it makes you feel anxious or upset.

words.ex: The school values diversity in its students.
words.ex_cn: 学校重视学生的多样性。
words.en: The state of being diverse; variety.

words.tr: n. 潜水；跳水； v. 潜水；跳水；“dive”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves diving in the clear sea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在清澈的海里潜水。
words.en: The sport or activity of swimming or exploring underwater.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.ex: The dog barks loudly at night.
words.ex_cn: 狗在晚上大声吠叫。
words.en: A dog is a very common four-legged animal that is often kept by people as a pet or to guard or hunt.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.ex: The hospital received a donation of books.
words.ex_cn: 医院收到了一批书籍捐赠。
words.en: A donation is a gift which is given to a charity or other organization.

words.ex: He closed the door quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻地关上了门。
words.en: A door is a piece of wood, glass, or metal, which is moved to open and close the entrance to a building, room, cupboard, or vehicle.

words.tr:
adj. 挨家挨户的；送货上门的
adv. 挨家挨户地；送货上门地
words.ex: He does door-to-door sales every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都进行上门推销。
words.en: Going to each house in an area to sell or deliver something, or to collect information.

words.ex: The bike ride is easy because it is downhill.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车很容易，因为是下山的。
words.en: If something or someone is moving downhill or is downhill, they are moving down a slope or are towards the bottom of a hill.

words.tr:
n. 饮料；酒；
v. 喝；喝酒；
words.ex: I bought a cold drink at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了一瓶冷饮。
words.en: To take liquid into the mouth and swallow it; a liquid that can be swallowed as refreshment or nourishment.

words.ex: He bought three drinks at the café.
words.ex_cn: 他在咖啡馆买了三杯饮料。
words.en: Drinks refer to liquids that can be consumed, typically including water, tea, coffee, and alcoholic beverages. As a verb, it means to take liquid into the mouth and swallow it.

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.ex: He is a drummer in a rock band.
words.ex_cn: 他是摇滚乐队的一名鼓手。
words.en: A drummer is a person who plays a drum or drums.

words.tr:
adj. 干的；
v. 变干；
words.ex: The cloth is dry after the sun.
words.ex_cn: 这块布在阳光下晒干了。
words.en: If something is dry, there is no water or moisture on it or in it.

words.ex: The duck swims in the pond.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子在池塘里游泳。
words.en: A duck is a bird that lives by water and has webbed feet, a short neck, and a large flat beak. As a verb, to duck means to lower the head or body quickly to avoid being hit or seen.

words.ex: The ducks swim in the pond.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子在池塘里游泳。
words.en: Ducks are birds that are related to geese and swans. They are mostly aquatic birds, mostly smaller than the swans and geese, and may be found in both fresh water and sea water.

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.ex: The worker wore a mask to avoid breathing in dust.
words.ex_cn: 这位工人戴上口罩以避免吸入粉尘。
words.en: Dust is a layer of fine, dry particles on the surface of something, or the fine, dry particles themselves.

words.ex: He hurt his ear while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了耳朵。
words.en: The organ of hearing in humans and other vertebrates, especially the external part of this organ.

words.ex: The baby covers his ears when the noise is loud.
words.ex_cn: 当噪音很大时，婴儿会捂住耳朵。
words.en: The organs of hearing and balance in humans and other vertebrates, especially the external part of these organs.

words.tr:
n. 日食；月食；黯然失色
v. 使失色
words.ex: We watched the solar eclipse last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚观看了日食。
words.en: An eclipse occurs when one celestial body moves into the shadow of another, temporarily obscuring it or cutting off its light.

words.ex: The economic situation is getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 经济状况正在恶化。
words.en: Economic means concerned with the organization of the money, industry, and trade of a country, region, or society.

words.ex: The editing of the book took three months.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的编辑花了三个月。
words.en: The process of revising and preparing a written, recorded, or filmed material for publication or presentation.

words.tr: n. 影响；作用；效果；效应；
words.ex: The new law had a big effect on traffic.
words.ex_cn: 新法律对交通产生了很大影响。
words.en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.

words.ex: She completed the task effectively.
words.ex_cn: 她有效地完成了任务。
words.en: In a way that produces the intended result or a successful outcome.

words.ex: She boiled an egg for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她为早餐煮了一个蛋。
words.en: An egg is an oval object that is produced by a female bird and which contains a baby bird. Other animals such as reptiles and fish also lay eggs.

words.ex: The rubber band is elastic.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋是有弹性的。
words.en: An elastic material is able to stretch and then return to its original shape or size.

words.ex: The electrician fixed the broken light.
words.ex_cn: 电工修好了坏掉的灯。
words.en: An electrician is a person whose job is to install and repair electrical equipment.

words.ex: The town lost electricity during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间，这个城镇停电了。
words.en: A form of energy resulting from the existence of charged particles (such as electrons or protons), either statically as an accumulation of charge or dynamically as a current.

words.ex: He sends an email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发一封电子邮件。
words.en: Email is a system for sending messages from one computer to another via the Internet.

words.ex: He went to the embassy to get a visa.
words.ex_cn: 他去大使馆办理签证。
words.en: An embassy is a group of officials who represent their country in a foreign country, or the building where they work.

words.ex: He called an emergency doctor when he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到不舒服时，他叫了急诊医生。
words.en: An emergency is an unexpected and usually dangerous situation that calls for immediate action.

words.ex: He showed strong emotion when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，表现出了强烈的情绪。
words.en: An emotion is a feeling such as happiness, love, fear, anger, or hatred, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

words.ex: The teacher put emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天都要阅读。
words.en: Special importance, value, or prominence given to something.

words.ex: He found employment after graduating from university.
words.ex_cn: 他大学毕业后找到了工作。
words.en: the condition of having paid work

words.ex: China uses a lot of energy from coal.
words.ex_cn: 中国使用大量煤炭能源。
words.en: Energy is the ability and strength to do active physical things and the feeling that you are full of physical power and life.

words.ex: He was born in England.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在英格兰。
words.en: England is a country that is part of the United Kingdom. It shares land borders with Scotland to the north and Wales to the west; the Irish Sea is to the north west, the Celtic Sea to the south west, while the North Sea to the east and the English Channel to the south separate it from continental Europe.

words.tr:
n. 英语；英文；
adj. 英格兰的；英格兰人的；英语的；
words.ex: He speaks English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天说英语。
words.en: English refers to the language spoken in Britain, the United States, and many other parts of the world, as well as to the people of England.

words.tr: n. 入会；入学 ；登记；注册；加入人数
words.ex: His enrollment in the club was approved last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被批准加入该俱乐部。
words.en: The act of officially joining a course, school, etc., or the number of people who do this.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
