v. 通过；传递；路过；(时间)流逝；
n. 通行证；(考试)及格；
words.ex: He passed the exam with a high score.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: To move or go past someone or something; to transfer or hand over something to someone.

words.ex: He showed his passport at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的护照。
words.en: A passport is an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country and gives you the right to travel to and from that country.

words.ex: The path leads to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这条路通向村庄。
words.en: A path is a way or track designed for walking or traveling along, especially through the countryside.

words.tr:
n. 病人；
adj. 有耐心的；
words.ex: The doctor helped the patient feel better.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助病人感觉好些了。
words.en: A patient person is able to wait for a long time or deal with a difficult situation without becoming angry or upset.

words.ex: The doctors care for many patients every day.
words.ex_cn: 医生每天照顾许多病人。
words.en: People who are receiving medical treatment or care, especially in a hospital.

words.ex: The pattern of the wallpaper is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 墙纸的图案非常简单。
words.en: A pattern is the repeated or regular way in which something happens or is done.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.tr:
n. 高峰；顶峰；
v. 达到高峰；达到最高值；
words.ex: The mountain peak is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的高峰被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

words.ex: He writes with a black pen.
words.ex_cn: 他用一支黑色钢笔写字。
words.en: A pen is a tool used for writing or drawing with ink.

words.ex: He uses a pencil to write his name.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔写自己的名字。
words.en: A pencil is an instrument that you use for writing or drawing, consisting of a thin stick of wood with a rod of a black or coloured substance through the middle.

words.ex: There are 38 people in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 教室里有38个人。
words.en: People are men, women, and children. People is often used to refer to a large group of people, especially when their exact number is not known or not important.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: She bought a new perfume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一瓶新香水。
words.en: A perfume is a pleasant-smelling liquid which people put on their skin to make themselves smell nice.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.ex: This is my personal notebook.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的个人笔记本。
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.ex: He is persuading his friend to join the team.
words.ex_cn: 他正在说服他的朋友加入团队。
words.en: To persuade someone means to cause them to do or believe something, especially by giving them a good reason to do it or by talking to them and making them believe it.

words.ex: His speech was persuasive and made everyone agree.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲很有说服力，让所有人都同意了。
words.en: A persuasive argument or reason is one that makes you believe that something is true or right.

words.ex: The farmer tried to kill the pest with a spray.
words.ex_cn: 农民试图用喷雾杀死害虫。
words.en: A pest is an animal or insect that damages crops, food, or livestock, or is generally troublesome. It can also refer to a person or thing that causes annoyance or trouble.

words.ex: Farmers use pesticide to kill insects on crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用杀虫剂来杀死作物上的昆虫。
words.en: A pesticide is a chemical substance used to kill pests, especially insects, that damage crops or are harmful to human health.

words.ex: My dog is my favorite pet.
words.ex_cn: 我的狗是我最喜欢的宠物。
words.en: A pet is an animal that you keep in your home to give you company and pleasure.

words.ex: My pets are a cat and a dog.
words.ex_cn: 我的宠物是一只猫和一只狗。
words.en: Animals kept for companionship or pleasure.

words.ex: He buys petrol every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五买汽油。
words.en: A liquid obtained from petroleum, used especially as a fuel in cars.

words.tr:
n. 电话；
v. 打电话；
words.ex: I lost my phone yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天丢了电话。
words.en: A phone is a piece of equipment that you use to talk to someone who is in another place.

words.ex: He took a photo of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的照片。
words.en: A photo is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.tr:
n. 照片；相片；
v. 拍照；
words.ex: He showed me a photograph of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他狗的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: He likes to study physics in school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在学校学习物理。
words.en: Physics is the scientific study of matter, energy, force, and motion, and how they relate to each other.

words.tr: n. 钢琴家；钢琴弹奏者；
words.ex: The pianist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位钢琴家在音乐会上演奏了一首美妙的曲子。
words.en: A pianist is a person who plays the piano, especially professionally.

words.ex: He plays the piano every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上弹钢琴。
words.en: A piano is a large musical instrument with a keyboard. When you press the keys, small hammers hit strings inside the piano, which produce musical notes.

words.tr:
n. 野餐；
v. 去野餐；
words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐了。
words.en: A picnic is a meal eaten outdoors, especially in the countryside, usually as part of a trip or outing.

words.tr:
n. 图画；照片；
v. 想象；
words.ex: The child drew a picture of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting. It can also refer to a movie or a description that creates a mental image.

words.tr:
n. 件；作品；片；块；
v. 拼凑；
words.ex: She bought a piece of cake.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一块蛋糕。
words.en: A piece of something is an amount of it that has been broken off, torn off, or cut off.

words.ex: The pirate sailed the sea with a black flag.
words.ex_cn: 海盗带着黑旗在海上航行。
words.en: A pirate is someone who attacks and robs ships at sea. The term can also refer to someone who illegally copies and distributes software, music, or films.

words.tr: n. 比萨饼；披萨；意大利薄饼；
words.ex: I ate a pizza for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了一块比萨饼。
words.en: A pizza is a flat, round piece of dough baked with tomato, cheese, and sometimes other ingredients on top.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.tr: v. 计划；“plan”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 计划了的；根据计划的；
words.ex: He planned a trip to the beach last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周计划了一次去海滩的旅行。
words.en: Something that is planned is arranged or prepared in advance.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物长在窗边。
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.tr:
n. 塑料；
adj. 塑料的；
words.ex: The bottle is made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是塑料做的。
words.en: A plastic is a material which is produced from oil by a chemical process and which is used to make many objects. It is light in weight and does not break easily.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.ex: The teacher stood on the platform to speak.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在平台上讲话。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure, usually made of wood, which people stand on when they make speeches or give performances.

words.ex: We watched three plays last week.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周看了三部戏剧。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.tr: n. 运动员；选手；唱机；玩家；
words.ex: The player scored a goal in the final minute.
words.ex_cn: 这名运动员在最后一分钟进了一球。
words.en: A player is someone who takes part in a game or sport, or someone who performs in a theatrical production or musical performance.

words.ex: The children are playing on the playground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐场上玩耍。
words.en: A playground is an area designed for children to play in, especially at a school or in a park.

words.ex: He listens to a podcast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听播客。
words.en: A podcast is a digital audio file made available on the internet for downloading to a computer or mobile device, typically available as a series, new installments of which can be received by subscribers automatically.

words.tr:
n. 警方；警察部门；
v. 监督；
words.ex: The police caught the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警方昨晚抓到了小偷。
words.en: The police are the official organization that is responsible for making sure that people obey the law, for catching criminals, and for keeping public order.

words.ex: He is interested in political news.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治新闻感兴趣。
words.en: Relating to the government or public affairs of a country.

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.ex: The river is dirty because of pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这条河因为污染而变得肮脏。
words.en: Pollution is the process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.ex: Ducks swim in the pond.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子在池塘里游泳。
words.en: A pond is a small area of water that is smaller than a lake, often artificially created.

words.tr: n. 水塘；水池；备用物资；美式撞球；
words.ex: The children play near the small pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在小水塘边玩耍。
words.en: A pool is a small area of still water, especially one that is artificially created.

words.tr: adj. 拙劣的；贫穷的；缺少的；可怜的；
words.ex: The acting in that movie was poor.
words.ex_cn: 那部电影的表演很拙劣。
words.en: If you describe someone as poor, you mean that they do not have enough money to live on or that they have very little money.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the port at noon.
words.ex_cn: 船在中午到达了港口。
words.en: A port is a place where ships load and unload goods or passengers.

words.ex: This portable charger works well on trips.
words.ex_cn: 这个便携式充电器在旅行时很好用。
words.en: Capable of being carried or moved about with ease.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；职位；邮寄；帖子；柱；
v. 邮寄；张贴；
words.ex: I checked the post this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上检查了邮件。
words.en: To post something means to send it through the postal system or to display it publicly, such as on a noticeboard or the internet. It can also refer to the act of assigning someone to a particular job or position.

words.ex: He put the letter in the postbox.
words.ex_cn: 他把信放进邮箱里。
words.en: A postbox is a public box with a slot into which letters are put for collection by the post office.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.ex: His hard work received much praise from the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力工作得到了老师的许多赞美。
words.en: If you praise someone or something, you express approval for their achievements or qualities.

words.tr: n. 掠夺者；捕食性动物；食肉动物；
words.ex: The lion is a predator that hunts deer.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种捕食鹿的掠夺者。
words.en: A predator is an animal that naturally preys on others.

words.ex: Lions and wolves are predators.
words.ex_cn: 狮子和狼是食肉动物。
words.en: Predators are animals that naturally prey on others.

words.ex: The weather was predictable today, just like yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气和昨天一样，是可以预见的。
words.en: If you say that an event or a situation is predictable, you mean that it is obvious in advance that it will happen or what it will be like.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.ex_cn: 目前的形势非常困难。
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.ex: The museum focuses on the preservation of old books.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆专注于旧书的保存。
words.en: The act of keeping something in its original state or in good condition.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.ex: The price of bread is too high.
words.ex_cn: 面包的价格太高了。
words.en: The amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

words.ex: The prices of fruits went up last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周水果的价格上涨了。
words.en: The amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.ex: The prince rode a white horse through the castle gate.
words.ex_cn: 王子骑着一匹白马穿过城堡的大门。
words.en: A prince is a male member of a royal family, especially the son of a king or queen.

words.ex: The printer is out of paper.
words.ex_cn: 打印机没有纸了。
words.en: A printer is a machine that can be connected to a computer in order to make copies on paper of documents or other information held by the computer.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: She sorted her priorities before starting the project.
words.ex_cn: 她在开始项目之前整理了优先次序。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.ex: He values his privacy and doesn't share personal info online.
words.ex_cn: 他重视自己的隐私，不在网上分享个人信息。
words.en: The state or condition of being free from being observed or disturbed by other people.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.tr:
n. 奖赏；奖品；奖金；
v. 珍视；
words.ex: He won a prize for the best science project.
words.ex_cn: 他因最好的科学项目获得了奖赏。
words.en: A prize is something valuable, such as money or a trophy, that is given to someone who wins a competition or who has done outstanding work.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学难题很难。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.tr: n. 处理；加工； v. 处理；加工；“process”的现在分词；
words.ex: The processing of data takes a long time.
words.ex_cn: 数据的处理需要很长时间。
words.en: The act of treating or preparing something by a special method.

words.ex: The professor teaches physics at the university.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授在大学教物理。
words.en: A professor is a senior teacher in a college or university.

words.tr: n. 受公众注意的程度；简介；轮廓；
words.ex: The celebrity's profile rose after the TV interview.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人经过电视采访后，受公众注意的程度提高了。
words.en: A profile is a side view of something, especially a person's face, or a brief description of someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 利润；
v. 获利；
words.ex: The company made a big profit this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profit is the amount of money that you gain when you are paid more for something than it cost you to make, get, or do it.

words.tr:
n. 节目；程序；
v. 编程；
words.ex: We watched a funny program on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在电视上看了一个有趣的节目。
words.en: A program is a set of instructions that a computer follows in order to perform a particular task.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.tr: adj. 受保护的； v. 保护；“protect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The protected forest is home to many rare animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个受保护的森林是许多稀有动物的家园。
words.en: If something is protected, it is kept safe from harm or damage.

words.ex: The helmet gives protection to his head.
words.ex_cn: 头盔保护他的头部。
words.en: Protection is the act of protecting someone or something, or the state of being protected.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: The publication of his book was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 他的书的出版被推迟了。
words.en: The act of making something available to the public, especially a book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.ex: He solved the crossword puzzle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解开了这个填字谜。
words.en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

words.ex: The quality of this phone is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的质量很高。
words.en: The standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind; the degree of excellence of something.

words.ex: The quantity of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: A quantity is an amount that you can measure or count.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.tr:
n. 问题；疑问；
v. 怀疑；询问；
words.ex: He asked a simple question in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上问了一个简单的问题。
words.en: A sentence or phrase used to find out information.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.ex: He ran quickly to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跑着去赶公交车。
words.en: In a fast or rapid manner.

words.ex: The students participated in a history quiz at school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们参加了学校举办的历史知识竞赛。
words.en: A quiz is a test or a game in which someone asks you questions to find out how much you know about a subject.

words.tr:
n. 赛跑；竞争；种族；
v. 比赛；快速移动；
words.ex: He won the race by running fast.
words.ex_cn: 他通过快速奔跑赢得了赛跑。
words.en: A race is a competition to see who is the fastest, for example in running, swimming, or driving.

words.ex: The children run in races every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每周五参加比赛。
words.en: Races can refer to a competition of speed, as in running, or to a group of people united by common history, nationality, or geographic distribution.

words.tr: n. 无线电；无线电广播；收音机；
words.ex: He listens to the radio every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听无线电。
words.en: A radio is the equipment that you use to listen to broadcasts of news, music, and other programs.

words.ex: The rain fell all night.
words.ex_cn: 雨下了一整夜。
words.en: Rain is water that falls from the clouds in small drops.

words.ex: The rainbow appears after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后出现了彩虹。
words.en: A rainbow is an arch of different colors that appears in the sky when the sun shines through rain.

words.ex: Last month's rainfall was very low.
words.ex_cn: 上个月的降雨量非常少。
words.en: Rainfall is the amount of rain that falls in a particular area during a particular period.

words.ex: He picked a random number to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他随意选了一个数字来赢得奖品。
words.en: If you describe something as random, you mean that it happens or is chosen without any definite plan, pattern, or purpose.

words.ex: The cat chased the rat under the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫追着老鼠跑到了桌子底下。
words.en: A rat is a small animal with a long tail that looks like a large mouse and is considered a pest.

words.tr:
n. 率；速度；比率；价格；费用；
v. 被评价；定级；（被）认为；
words.ex: The interest rate is very low this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的利率非常低。
words.en: A rate is the speed at which something happens or changes, or the amount or number of something that happens or changes in a particular period.

words.tr: n. 阅读；读物； v. 读；“read”的现在分词；
words.ex: Reading is an important skill for students.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学生的重要技能。
words.en: The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.

words.tr:
n. 原因；理由；理性；
v. 推理；推断；
words.ex: The reason for his absence is sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他缺席的原因是生病。
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.ex: He gave a reasonable answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个合理的回答。
words.en: Fair and sensible; not excessive or extreme.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.tr: n. 录音；录制； v. 记录；录制；“record”的现在分词；
words.ex: I listened to the recording of the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我听了讲座的录音。
words.en: A recording is a piece of music or speech that has been recorded, or the process of making such a record.

words.ex: He needs time for recovery after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他手术后需要时间恢复。
words.en: The process of becoming well again after an illness or injury, or the process of returning to a normal condition after a period of difficulty.

words.tr:
adj. 红的；
n. 红色；
words.ex: The apple is red.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果是红的。
words.en: Red is the colour of blood or of ripe tomatoes.

words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.ex: The reduction in cost helped the company save money.
words.ex_cn: 成本的减少帮助公司节省了资金。
words.en: The act of making something smaller in size, amount, degree, importance, etc., or the result of this.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: He became reflective after reading the old letter.
words.ex_cn: 他读完那封旧信后变得沉思起来。
words.en: If you are reflective, you are thinking deeply about something.

words.ex: We had a snack and some drinks as refreshment after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后，我们吃了点心和喝了一些饮料作为茶点。
words.en: Refreshment refers to the act of refreshing or the state of being refreshed, especially by food or drink. It can also mean a light meal or drinks served in a social setting.

words.ex: We served refreshments after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议后我们提供了茶点。
words.en: Light snacks and drinks served to guests or participants at an event.

words.ex: This festival is a regional tradition.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日是一个地区的传统。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a region.

words.tr:
adj. 有规律的；经常的；常见的；
n. 常客；
words.ex: He goes for a run every morning, a regular habit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步，这是一个有规律的习惯。
words.en: Something that is regular happens or is done at equal intervals or is consistent in pattern or occurrence.

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.ex: Exercise can reinforce your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.ex: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: A relationship is the way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

words.tr:
adj. 相对的；相关联的；
n. 亲戚；
words.ex: His success is relative to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功是相对于他的努力而言的。
words.en: A relative is someone who is part of your family. Parents, siblings, uncles, aunts, grandparents, cousins, nieces and nephews — they're all relatives.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.tr:
n. 修理；修补；
v. 修理；修补；
words.ex: The repair of the car took two days.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的修理花了两天时间。
words.en: To repair something that is damaged or not working properly means to fix it.

words.tr: v. 重复；“repeat”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 重复的；反复发生的；
words.ex: He repeated the words after the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他跟着老师重复了这些话。
words.en: Something that is repeated happens or is done more than once.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.ex: The reproduction of rabbits is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 兔子的生殖速度很快。
words.en: The process of producing offspring or new individuals of the same species, or the act of making a copy of something.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.ex: The researcher studies how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这位研究人员研究植物是如何生长的。
words.en: A researcher is someone who conducts research, especially as a job.

words.ex: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我在餐厅预订了两个人的座位。
words.en: A reservation is an arrangement whereby something, especially a seat or room, is kept for a particular person who will arrive later.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.ex: His residence is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所靠近公园。
words.en: A residence is a house or place where someone lives.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: A resource is a source or supply from which benefit is produced. Typically resources are materials, energy, services, staff, knowledge, or other assets that are transformed to produce benefit and in the process may be consumed or made unavailable.

words.tr:
n. 方面；尊重；尊敬；
v. 遵从；尊重；尊敬；
words.ex: In this respect, the plan is good.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方面，这个计划很好。
words.en: If you respect someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas.

words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: There is a restriction on smoking in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里禁止吸烟。
words.en: A restriction is an official rule that limits what you can do or that limits the amount or size of something.

words.tr:
n. 返回；归还；
v. 返回；归还；
words.ex: The return of the train was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 火车的返回被推迟了。
words.en: To go or come back to a place or person. To give, send, or put something back to its original place or condition.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.ex: He eats rice every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃米饭。
words.en: Rice is a cereal grain that is the most widely consumed staple food for a large part of the world's human population, especially in Asia.

words.tr:
n. 风险；
v. 冒...的危险；
words.ex: He took a risk by starting his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他创业时承担了风险。
words.en: If there is a risk of something unpleasant, there is a possibility that it will happen.

words.ex: The children play near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边玩耍。
words.en: A river is a large natural stream of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.

words.ex: We walked along the riverside at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 我们在日落时沿着河边散步。
words.en: The area of land along the edge of a river.

words.ex: The road is long and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 这条路又长又安静。
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.ex: The robbery happened at the bank yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天银行发生了抢劫。
words.en: The crime of stealing from someone or somewhere, especially using violence or threats.

words.ex: The robot cleans the floor every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人每天打扫地板。
words.en: A robot is a machine that is programmed to move and perform certain tasks automatically.

words.tr:
n. 岩石；摇滚乐；
v. （使）摇动；（使）摇晃；
words.ex: The children climbed on the big rock near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边的大岩石上攀爬。
words.en: A rock is a large piece of stone that forms part of a hill or mountain. Rock can also refer to a type of music that is loud and has a strong beat. As a verb, to rock means to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

words.tr:
n. 根；根源；
v. 生根；
words.ex: The root of 9 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 9的平方根是3。
words.en: The root of a plant is the part that grows underground and absorbs water and minerals. It can also refer to the origin or cause of something.

words.ex: He tied the box with a strong rope.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根结实的绳子把箱子绑了起来。
words.en: A rope is a thick cord made by twisting together strands of natural fibers such as hemp or artificial fibers such as nylon.

words.tr: n. 玫瑰； v. 上升；提高；“rise”的过去式；
words.ex: She picked a red rose from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她从花园里摘了一朵红玫瑰。
words.en: A rose is a flower, often with a pleasant smell, which grows on a bush with thorns on the stems.

words.ex: She picked red roses for her mother.
words.ex_cn: 她为母亲摘了红玫瑰。
words.en: Roses are a type of flower known for their beauty and fragrance, often used in gardens and as gifts.

words.ex: The wood surface is rough.
words.ex_cn: 木头表面很粗糙。
words.en: If a surface is rough, it is not smooth and has bumps or uneven areas.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 环绕；附近；
adj. 圆的；十足的；
n. 回合；圆形物；
v. 拐过；使成圆形；
words.ex: The children sat round the fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们围坐在火堆旁。
words.en: Something that is round is shaped like a circle or a ball.

words.ex: We took a different route to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们换了条路线以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A route is a way from one place to another, or the path that something follows to reach a destination.

words.ex: The boy picked up a piece of rubber from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块橡胶。
words.en: Rubber is a strong, waterproof, elastic substance made from the juice of some tropical plants or artificially. It is used for making tires, boots, and many other products.

words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.tr:
n. 规则；统治；
v. 统治；
words.ex: The teacher made a new rule for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师制定了一个新的作业规则。
words.en: A rule is a statement telling people what they should do in order to achieve success or a benefit of some kind.

words.tr: n. 跑；管理；运作； v. 经营；跑步；“run”的现在分词； adj. 运作中的；流动的；持续的；
words.ex: Running is his favorite exercise.
words.ex_cn: 跑步是他最喜欢的锻炼方式。
words.en: The act of moving swiftly on foot so that both feet leave the ground during each stride.

words.ex: The children are playing in a safe park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在安全的公园里玩耍。
words.en: If something or someone is safe, they are not in danger or likely to be harmed.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet improves your safety.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔能提高你的安全。
words.en: Safety refers to the condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger, risk, or injury.

words.ex: I ate a fresh salad for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了一份新鲜的色拉。
words.en: A salad is a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, cucumber, and tomatoes, often served with a dressing.

words.ex: She added a little salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她在汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: Salt is a white crystalline substance that is used for seasoning or preserving food. It is also used in various industrial processes.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.ex: We go to the park on Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期六去公园。
words.en: Saturday is the day of the week that comes after Friday and before Sunday.

words.ex: She wore a warm scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: A scarf is a piece of cloth that you wear around your neck or head, usually to keep yourself warm.

words.ex: She was wearing a variety of colorful scarves.
words.ex_cn: 她戴着各种颜色的围巾。
words.en: Lightweight, often decorative neckwear made from fabric like silk or wool.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.ex: The scientist studies stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究夜空中的恒星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.ex: He lives in Scotland.
words.ex_cn: 他住在苏格兰。
words.en: Scotland is a country that is part of the United Kingdom, known for its distinct culture, history, and landscapes.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: The fish swim in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海里游泳。
words.en: The sea is the salty water that covers about three-quarters of the Earth's surface.

words.tr: n. 海产食物（如海鱼、贝类等）；
words.ex: We ate fresh seafood at the seaside restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海边的餐厅吃了新鲜的海产食物。
words.en: Seafood refers to fish and shellfish from the sea that are eaten as food.

words.tr: adj. 中等的；次要的；第二的；
words.ex: He attends a secondary school in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里上一所中学。
words.en: If you describe something as secondary, you mean that it is less important than something else.

words.tr: adj. 需要久坐的；惯于久坐不动的；不爱活动的；
words.ex: His sedentary job makes him sit all day.
words.ex_cn: 他的久坐工作让他整天坐着。
words.en: Someone who has a sedentary lifestyle or job sits down a lot of the time and does not take much exercise.

words.ex: Rivers carry sediment to the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流把沉积物带到大海。
words.en: Material that settles to the bottom of a liquid; matter that has been deposited by some natural process.

words.tr:
n. 种子；籽；
v. 播种；
words.ex: The farmer planted the seed in the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把种子种在土里。
words.en: A seed is the small, hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows.

words.ex: He learned to love his self.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了爱自己。
words.en: Your self is your basic personality or nature, especially considered in terms of what you are really like as a person.

words.tr: adj. 自己经营的；个体经营的；非受雇于人的
words.ex: He is self-employed and works from home.
words.ex_cn: 他是自由职业者，在家工作。
words.en: Someone who is self-employed works for themselves rather than for an employer.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: He was born in September.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在九月。
words.en: September is the ninth month of the year in the Gregorian calendar, coming after August and before October.

words.ex: The servant cleaned the house every morning.
words.ex_cn: 仆人每天早上打扫房子。
words.en: A servant is someone who is employed to work in another person's house, doing jobs such as cooking and cleaning.

words.tr: n. 定居点；定居（过程）；协议；
words.ex: The small settlement near the river has five houses.
words.ex_cn: 河边的小定居点有五所房子。
words.en: A settlement is an official agreement intended to resolve a dispute or conflict.

words.ex: He learned about sex in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学到了性。
words.en: Sex refers to the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences rather than biological ones.

words.ex: The shady spot under the tree is cool.
words.ex_cn: 树下的背阴处很凉爽。
words.en: If you describe a person or activity as shady, you mean that they seem dishonest or illegal.

words.tr:
n. 形状；身材；定形；
v. 塑造；
words.ex: The shape of the table is round.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子的形状是圆形的。
words.en: The shape of an object is its external form or outline, which can be seen and felt.

words.tr: adj. 共享的；共同的； v. 共享；分享；“share”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They use a shared kitchen in the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公寓里，共用一个厨房。
words.en: Used to describe something that is used, held, or enjoyed by two or more people together.

words.ex: The sheep graze quietly in the field.
words.ex_cn: 绵羊在田野里安静地吃草。
words.en: A sheep is a farm animal which is covered with thick curly hair called wool. Sheep are kept for their wool or for their meat.

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.ex: He wears a white shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件白衬衫去上班。
words.en: A shirt is a piece of clothing for the upper body, typically having a collar, sleeves, and buttons down the front.

words.ex: He put on his shoe before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了鞋子。
words.en: A shoe is a covering for the foot, typically made of leather, having a sturdy sole and not reaching above the ankle.

words.ex: He bought new shoes for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为上学买了新鞋子。
words.en: Shoes are objects which you wear on your feet. They cover most of your foot and you wear them over socks or stockings.

words.tr:
n. 商店；
v. 购物；
words.ex: I bought bread from the local shop.
words.ex_cn: 我从附近的商店买了面包。
words.en: A shop is a place where goods are sold; also, to shop means to visit shops in order to buy things.

words.ex: I went shopping for groceries yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天去购物买杂货了。
words.en: The activity of buying things from shops.

words.ex: He rubbed his shoulder after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后揉了揉肩膀。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the upper limb or forelimb is attached; to accept or take on (a responsibility or task).

words.ex: I take a shower every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都洗淋浴。
words.en: A shower is a device that sprays water over you so that you can wash yourself. It is also a short period of rain or snow.

words.ex: He ate grilled shrimp for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了烤虾。
words.en: A shrimp is a small shellfish with a long tail and many legs, which can be eaten as food.

words.tr: v. 签名；“sign”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He signed the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在寄出信之前签了名。
words.en: Having a signature or signatures on it, typically to indicate approval, agreement, or authorization.

words.ex: The children were silent during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在看电影时很安静。
words.en: Someone or something that is silent makes no noise at all.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.ex: This is a simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是一道简单的数学题。
words.en: If you describe something as simple, you mean that it is not complicated, and is therefore easy to understand.

words.ex: He gave a situational answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个情境相关的回答。
words.en: Relating to or dependent on a set of circumstances or state of affairs.

words.ex: The size of the box is too big for the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小对架子来说太大了。
words.en: The physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of an object.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: The sky is the space around the Earth which you can see when you stand outside and look upwards.

words.ex: The slave worked in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个奴隶每天在田地里劳作。
words.en: A slave is someone who is the legal property of another person and is forced to obey them.

words.ex: The slaves worked in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 这些奴隶每天在田地里劳作。
words.en: A slave is a person who is the legal property of another and is forced to obey them.

words.ex: He learned about slavery in history class.
words.ex_cn: 他在历史课上学到了奴隶制。
words.en: Slavery is the system by which people are owned by other people as slaves.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.ex: He uses a smartphone to call his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他用智能手机给朋友打电话。
words.en: A smartphone is a mobile phone that can perform many of the functions of a computer, typically having a touchscreen interface, internet access, and an operating system capable of running downloaded applications.

words.tr:
n. 闻；气味；嗅觉；
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；
words.ex: The smell of fresh bread made me hungry.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味让我饿了。
words.en: The faculty or power of perceiving odors or scents by means of the organs in the nose.

words.tr:
v. 微笑；
n. 微笑；
words.ex: I smile every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天微笑。
words.en: A smile is the expression that you have on your face when you are happy or amused, or when you are being friendly. When you smile, the corners of your mouth curve up and you sometimes show your teeth.

words.ex: I ate an apple as a snack after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后吃了一个苹果当小吃。
words.en: A snack is a small amount of food that is eaten between meals.

words.ex: The snake crawled slowly through the grass.
words.ex_cn: 蛇在草丛中缓慢地爬行。
words.en: A snake is a long, thin creature with no legs that slides along the ground.

words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.ex: He put on his socks before leaving the house.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了袜子。
words.en: A piece of clothing which covers your foot and lower part of your leg, usually made of wool or cotton.

words.ex: He uses software to write his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他使用软件写作业。
words.en: Software refers to the programs and other operating information used by a computer.

words.ex: The farmer planted corn in rich soil.
words.ex_cn: 农民在肥沃的土壤里种了玉米。
words.en: Soil is the substance on the surface of the earth in which plants grow, consisting of rock and mineral particles mixed with decayed organic matter.

words.ex: The solar panel collects energy from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能板从太阳收集能量。
words.en: Solar means relating to the sun or using the energy from the sun to produce electricity.

words.tr:
n. 空间；太空；空格；
v. 以一定间隔排列；
words.ex: The room has enough space for a bed and a desk.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有足够的空间放一张床和一张书桌。
words.en: Space refers to the physical dimensions in which objects exist and move, including the vast expanse beyond the Earth's atmosphere, known as outer space. It can also denote the interval or distance between two or more objects, or a period of time. As a verb, it means to arrange with spaces in between.

words.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。
words.en: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled or knowledgeable in a particular field.

words.ex: He gave a short speech at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上做了一个简短的讲话。
words.en: Speech is the expression of or the ability to express thoughts and feelings by articulate sounds.

words.tr:
n. 速度；速率；
v. 加速；加快；
words.ex: The car's speed was too high on the wet road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在湿滑路面上的速度太快了。
words.en: Speed is the rate at which something moves or happens.

words.ex: She added cinnamon spice to the cake.
words.ex_cn: 她往蛋糕里加了肉桂香料。
words.en: Spice refers to a substance used to flavor food, which is usually made from parts of plants, especially their seeds, fruits, or roots. It can also mean something that adds interest or excitement.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon to eat the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把勺子喝汤。
words.en: A spoon is an object used for eating, stirring, and serving food. It has a small shallow bowl on a handle.

words.tr:
n. 春天；弹簧；泉；
v. 突然猛烈地移动；跳；
words.ex: Flowers bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天花朵盛开。
words.en: Spring is the season between winter and summer when plants begin to grow again. It is also a device that returns to its original shape after being compressed or stretched, or a natural source of water.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.ex: He put a stamp on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他在信封上贴了一张邮票。
words.en: A stamp is a small piece of paper which you stick on an envelope or package before you post it to pay for the cost of the postage. It can also mean to bring down your foot heavily on the ground or to impress a pattern or mark on a surface.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.ex: The kettle produces steam when the water boils.
words.ex_cn: 水烧开时，水壶会产生蒸汽。
words.en: Steam is the hot mist that forms when water boils. It can be used to power machines or to cook food.

words.tr:
n. 步；步骤；踏级；步伐；
v. 踩；踏；行走；
words.ex: He took a small step forward.
words.ex_cn: 他向前迈了一小步。
words.en: A step is an act or movement of putting one leg in front of the other in order to move forward, or a stage in a process.

words.tr: adj. 被偷走的； v. 偷；“steal”的过去分词；
words.ex: The stolen bike was found near the park.
words.ex_cn: 那辆被偷的自行车在公园附近找到了。
words.en: Taken without the owner's consent; obtained by theft.

words.ex: He ate too much and his stomach hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，胃疼。
words.en: The stomach is the organ in your body where food is digested after you have eaten it.

words.ex: The boy picked up a stone from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块石头。
words.en: A stone is a small piece of rock that is found on the ground.

words.ex: The storm broke out at night.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨在夜间爆发了。
words.en: A storm is very bad weather, with heavy rain, strong winds, and often thunder and lightning.

words.tr: n. 故事；小说；轶事；假话；
words.ex: He told a funny story to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他给孩子们讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A story is a description of imaginary people and events, which is written or told in order to entertain.

words.tr:
n. 压力；（动植物的）品种；
v. 竭力；
words.ex: The job gave him a lot of strain.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作给他带来了很大的压力。
words.en: To strain means to make a great effort to do something, to pull or stretch something tightly, or to injure a muscle by stretching it too much.

words.tr: n. 新来者；陌生人； adj. “strange”的比较级；
words.ex: He is a stranger in this town.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个镇上的新来者。
words.en: A stranger is someone you have never met before.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.ex: The bridge has a strong structural design.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有坚固的结构设计。
words.en: Relating to the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.tr:
n. 学习；研究；书房；
v. 学习；研究；
words.ex: His study of biology took five years.
words.ex_cn: 他对生物学的学习持续了五年。
words.en: The activity of learning or gaining knowledge, especially from books, or a detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation.

words.tr: n. 风格；方式；样式；文体；
words.ex: Her dress has a unique style.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子有一种独特的风格。
words.en: A particular kind, sort, or type, as with reference to form, appearance, or character.

words.ex: He put sugar in his tea.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖放进茶里。
words.en: A sweet substance that is used to make food and drinks sweet. It is usually in the form of white or brown crystals.

words.tr:
v. 适合；相配；
n. 套装；西装；诉讼；
words.ex: This color suits her well.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色很适合她。
words.en: A suit is a set of clothes made from the same fabric, usually consisting of a jacket and trousers or a skirt. As a verb, to suit means to be appropriate or acceptable for someone or something.

words.ex: She held a sunshade to block the bright sun.
words.ex_cn: 她撑着一把遮阳伞来挡住刺眼的阳光。
words.en: A sunshade is an object or device that provides protection from the sun's rays, typically consisting of a fabric canopy supported by a frame.

words.ex: His superiority in math helped him win the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上的优越让他赢得了比赛。
words.en: If one side in a war or conflict has superiority, it has an advantage over its enemy, for example because it has more soldiers or better equipment.

words.ex: The teacher supervises the students during the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师在实验期间指导学生。
words.en: If you supervise an activity or a person, you make sure that the activity is done correctly or that the person is doing a task or behaving correctly.

words.tr:
v. 支持；支撑；
n. 拥护；帮助；
words.ex: My friends support me when I feel sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我感到难过时，我的朋友们支持我。
words.en: If you support someone or their ideas or aims, you agree with them, and perhaps help them because you want them to succeed.

words.tr:
n. 表面；
v. 显露；
words.ex: The surface of the table is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的表面很光滑。
words.en: The outer or top part of something; to rise to the surface of water or to become known after being hidden or secret.

words.ex: The survival of the animals depends on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物的生存取决于天气。
words.en: The state or fact of continuing to live or exist, typically in spite of an accident, ordeal, or difficult circumstances.

words.tr:
n. 桌子；表格；台子；
v. 搁置；
words.ex: He put his books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: A table is a piece of furniture with a flat top that you put things on or use to do things such as eat, write, or work.

words.ex: The dog wagged its tail happily.
words.ex_cn: 狗开心地摇着尾巴。
words.en: The tail of an animal, bird, or fish is the part extending beyond the end of its body.

words.tr:
v. 交谈；说话；
n. 谈话；
words.ex: They talk every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后都会交谈。
words.en: To speak in order to give information or express ideas or feelings; conversation or discussion.

words.tr: n. 磁带；录音带；胶带；带子；
words.ex: He recorded the song on a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首歌录在磁带上。
words.en: A tape is a narrow strip of plastic or other material that is used for recording sound or pictures, or for sticking things together.

words.tr:
n. 味觉；味道；品味；喜好；
v. 品尝；有…味道；
words.ex: My taste can detect sweet and sour flavors.
words.ex_cn: 我的味觉能分辨甜味和酸味。
words.en: The sensation of flavor perceived in the mouth and throat on contact with a substance.

words.tr:
n. 税；税款；
v. 对...征税；
words.ex: He pays tax every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年缴税。
words.en: A tax is a sum of money that you have to pay to the government so that it can pay for public services.

words.ex: The government introduced new taxation on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 政府对糖征收了新的税。
words.en: Taxation refers to the system by which a government takes money from people and spends it on things such as education, health, and defense.

words.ex: I took a taxi to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我打了一辆出租车去机场。
words.en: A taxi is a car driven by someone whose job is to take people where they want to go in return for money.

words.ex: He drinks tea every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝茶。
words.en: Tea is a drink made by pouring boiling water onto the dried leaves of the tea bush. It is popular in many countries and is often served hot with milk and sugar.

words.ex: Our team won the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 我们的团队赢得了足球比赛。
words.en: A team is a group of people who play a particular sport or game together against other similar groups of people.

words.ex: He works in a technical department.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个技术部门工作。
words.en: Technical means involving the sorts of machines, processes, and materials that are used in industry, transport, and communications.

words.ex: New technology helps farmers grow more food.
words.ex_cn: 新技术帮助农民种植更多的粮食。
words.en: Technology refers to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

words.tr: n. （十三到十九岁的）青少年
words.ex: The teenager walks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个青少年每天步行上学。
words.en: A teenager is someone who is between thirteen and nineteen years old.

words.ex: He sent a telegraph to his family.
words.ex_cn: 他给家人发了一封电报。
words.en: A system for transmitting messages from a distance along a wire, especially one creating signals by making and breaking an electrical connection.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.ex: The ancient temple stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庙宇矗立在山上。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions.

words.ex: He took a temporary job during summer.
words.ex_cn: 他在暑假期间做了一份短暂的工作。
words.en: Something that is temporary lasts for only a limited time.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.ex: They slept in a tent during the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在露营时睡在帐篷里。
words.en: A tent is a portable shelter made of fabric or other material stretched over a supporting framework of poles and usually stabilized or secured to the ground with cords and stakes.

words.ex: The teacher will terminate the class at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 老师将在下午5点结束课程。
words.en: To terminate something means to bring it to an end or to stop it from continuing.

words.tr:
n. 试验；测验；
v. 试验；测试；
words.ex: The scientist ran a test to see if the drug works.
words.ex_cn: 科学家进行了一次试验，以查看这种药物是否有效。
words.en: A test is a series of questions or problems that is used to measure a person's ability or understanding of something.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of textile, like cotton and silk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售多种纺织品，比如棉和丝绸。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.ex: She sells textiles at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上卖纺织品。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.ex: We went to the theater to watch a play.
words.ex_cn: 我们去剧院看了一场话剧。
words.en: A theater is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: The theme of the essay is friendship.
words.ex_cn: 这篇作文的题目是友谊。
words.en: The subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing, or work of art.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.tr:
adj. 第三的；
n. 三分之一；第三；
adv. 第三；
words.ex: He finished in third place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第三名。
words.en: Coming after the second and just before the fourth in position.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Thursday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期四有一个会议。
words.en: Thursday is the day of the week between Wednesday and Friday.

words.ex: He bought a ticket for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张电影票。
words.en: A ticket is a small, official piece of paper or card which shows that you have paid to enter a place such as a theatre or a sports ground, or shows that you have paid for a journey.

words.ex: The tide comes in every twelve hours.
words.ex_cn: 潮汐每十二小时涨一次。
words.en: The tide is the regular change in the level of the sea on the shore.

words.ex: Her room is always tidy.
words.ex_cn: 她的房间总是很整洁。
words.en: If you describe something as tidy, you mean that it is neat and arranged in an orderly way.

words.ex: The tiger walks quietly in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 老虎在森林里静静地行走。
words.en: A tiger is a large wild animal that has a yellow and black striped coat and is a member of the cat family.

words.tr:
n. 时间；时期；次数；
v. 计时；安排时间；
words.ex: I don't have time to finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我没有时间完成作业。
words.en: Time is the ongoing sequence of existence and events that occurs in an apparently irreversible succession from the past, through the present, into the future.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.ex: The children licked their tongues after eating ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们吃完冰淇淋后舔了舔舌头。
words.en: The movable organ in the mouth, used in tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech; a language or dialect spoken by a particular people or in a particular region.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful tool for fixing things.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是修理东西的有用工具。
words.en: A tool is any instrument or simple piece of equipment that you hold in your hands and use to do a particular kind of work.

words.tr: v. 触摸；接触；“touch”的现在分词；
words.ex: The child is touching the soft blanket.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在触摸柔软的毯子。
words.en: If something is touching, it causes feelings of sadness or sympathy.

words.tr:
n. 塔；塔楼；
v. 高耸；
words.ex: The tower stands tall in the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这座塔矗立在城市中心。
words.en: A tower is a tall, narrow building, either part of a larger building such as a church or castle, or standing alone.

words.ex: He lives in a small town near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他住在山附近的一个小镇上。
words.en: A town is a place with many streets and buildings, where people live and work. It is larger than a village but smaller than a city.

words.ex: He wears traditional clothes on holidays.
words.ex_cn: 他在节日时穿传统服装。
words.en: Traditional refers to customs, beliefs, or methods that have existed for a long time without changing.

words.ex: The traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上高速公路上的交通非常拥堵。
words.en: Traffic refers to the movement of vehicles or people along roads, or to the movement of aircraft, ships, or trains. It can also refer to the trade or exchange of goods or services, especially illegal ones.

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: He takes the tram to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上乘电车上班。
words.en: A tram is a vehicle that is used for public transportation in cities and towns, running on tracks laid in the streets.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.tr: n. 运输；运输系统；交通工具；
words.ex: The city improved its transportation system.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了它的运输系统。
words.en: Transportation refers to the movement of people, animals, and goods from one place to another.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.ex: He placed the cups on a tray.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个托盘上。
words.en: A tray is a flat container, usually made of wood, plastic, or metal, with raised edges, used for carrying things such as food or drinks.

words.ex: The tree grows near the house.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树长在房子旁边。
words.en: A tree is a tall plant with a trunk and branches made of wood.

words.ex: He wears blue trousers to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Trousers are a piece of clothing that you wear over your body from the waist downwards, and that cover each leg separately.

words.tr: n. [英]地铁；管子；管状物；电视机；
words.ex: I take the tube to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A tube is a long, hollow cylinder used for conveying or holding liquids or gases.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Tuesday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期二有一个会议。
words.en: Tuesday is the day of the week following Monday and preceding Wednesday.

words.ex: He goes to university to study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他上大学学习工程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.ex: Many universities offer free math courses.
words.ex_cn: 许多大学提供免费的数学课程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.ex: It is unnecessary to bring an umbrella today.
words.ex_cn: 今天带伞是不必要的。
words.en: If you describe something as unnecessary, you mean that it is not needed or does not have to be done, and often that it may be harmful or undesirable.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: We went to the beach during our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去了海滩。
words.en: A vacation is a period of time devoted to pleasure, rest, or relaxation, especially one with pay granted to an employee.

words.tr: n. （同一事物）不同种类；多样性；（动植物的）品种；变化；
words.ex: The store sells a variety of apples.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的苹果。
words.en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.tr:
n. 素食者；食草动物；
adj. 素食者的；素菜的；
words.ex: He is a vegetarian and doesn't eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名素食者，不吃肉。
words.en: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

words.ex: The desert has little vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠植被很少。
words.en: Vegetation refers to plants in general, or the plants that are found in a particular area. It can also refer to a life that is dull or inactive, often due to illness or lack of exercise.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: A village is a small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉小提琴。
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.ex: Eating fruits gives you vitamin C.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果可以给你维生素C。
words.en: A vitamin is one of a group of organic substances which are essential in small quantities to the nutrition of most animals and some plants, and which are present in natural foodstuffs or sometimes produced within the body.

words.ex: She eats fruits to get vitamins.
words.ex_cn: 她吃水果来获取维生素。
words.en: Vitamins are substances that are found in foods and are necessary for normal growth and health.

words.ex: He improved his vocabulary by reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天阅读来提高自己的词汇量。
words.en: The vocabulary of a person is all the words that they know or use in a particular language.

words.tr:
v. 等待；等候；
n. 等待；等候；
words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上等公交车。
words.en: to stay in one place or not do something until something else happens, someone arrives, etc.

words.ex: The waiter brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waiter is a man who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

words.ex: He paints the wall blue.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙涂成蓝色。
words.en: A wall is a vertical structure, often made of stone or brick, that divides or encloses an area of land.

words.tr:
n. 垃圾；废物；浪费；
v. 浪费；白费；糟蹋；
adj. 荒芜的；废弃的；
words.ex: The children threw waste into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you waste something such as time, money, or energy, you use too much of it doing something that is not important or necessary, or you do not use it in a sensible way.

words.tr:
n. 水；
v. 给…浇水；给（某地）供水；
words.ex: She drinks water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝水。
words.en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and plants need water in order to live.

words.ex: The waterfall makes a loud sound.
words.ex_cn: 瀑布发出很大的声音。
words.en: A waterfall is a place where water flows over the edge of a steep, high cliff in hills or mountains, and falls into a pool below.

words.ex: He built his wealth by starting a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过创办一家小企业积累了财富。
words.en: Wealth refers to an abundance of valuable possessions or money.

words.ex: The weather is sunny today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气晴朗。
words.en: The condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, especially with regard to temperature, precipitation, and wind.

words.ex: The wedding was held in a small church.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼在一座小教堂举行。
words.en: A wedding is a marriage ceremony and the party or special meal that often takes place after the ceremony.

words.ex: I will see you next week.
words.ex_cn: 我下周见你。
words.en: A week is a period of seven days.

words.ex: I will visit you this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我这周末去看你。
words.en: The weekend is Saturday and Sunday, the two days in the week when many people do not work.

words.tr: n. 重量；重物；重要性；负担；
words.ex: The weight of the box is 10 kilograms.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子的重量是10公斤。
words.en: Weight is the force with which a body is attracted toward the earth or a celestial body by gravitation and which is equal to the product of the mass and the local gravitational acceleration.

words.tr:
n. 西方；
adj. 西方的；
adv. 在西方；
words.ex: The address is 1071 West Street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是西街1071号。
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun sets at the equinoxes, on the left-hand side of a person facing north, or the part of the horizon lying in this direction.

words.ex: The ground is wet after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是湿的。
words.en: If something is wet, it is covered in water, rain, sweat, tears, or another liquid.

words.ex: The wetland is home to many birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片湿地是许多鸟类的家园。
words.en: Wetlands are areas where water covers the soil, or is present either at or near the surface of the soil all year or for varying periods of time during the year, including during the growing season.

words.ex: He blew a whistle to get our attention.
words.ex_cn: 他吹了一声口哨来引起我们的注意。
words.en: A whistle is a small metal tube which you blow in order to produce a loud sound and attract someone's attention. A whistle is also the sound that you make when you blow a whistle or when you whistle.

words.ex: The hotel offers free wifi for guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店为客人提供免费无线网络。
words.en: A technology that allows electronic devices to connect to a wireless local area network (WLAN).

words.ex: She opened the window to let in fresh air.
words.ex_cn: 她打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。
words.en: A window is a space in the wall of a building or in the side of a vehicle, which has glass in it so that light can pass through and people can see out.

words.ex: He drinks wine with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他吃饭时喝葡萄酒。
words.en: An alcoholic drink made from fermented grape juice.

words.ex: The bird spread its wing to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞翔。
words.en: One of the two flat parts that stick out from the side of a bird's body and are used for flying.

words.ex: He used a thin wire to fix the broken hook.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根细金属丝固定了坏掉的钩子。
words.en: A wire is a long thin piece of metal that is used to fasten things or to carry electric current.

words.ex: There are 31 women in the meeting room.
words.ex_cn: 会议室里有31名女性。
words.en: Women are adult human females.

words.ex: The house is built with wood.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子是用木材建造的。
words.en: Wood is the material which forms the trunks and branches of trees. It is used for building and making things.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.tr: n. 练习册；作业本；工作簿
words.ex: He uses a workbook to practice math every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天用练习册练习数学。
words.en: A workbook is a book containing exercises and problems for students to practice and learn from.

words.ex: He loves the world and wants to travel everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱这个世界，想要去所有地方旅行。
words.en: The earth, together with all of its countries, peoples, and natural features.

words.tr: adj. 更坏的；更糟糕的；“bad”的比较级； adv. 更糟；更坏；
words.ex: The weather got worse after noon.
words.ex_cn: 下午之后天气变得更坏了。
words.en: Comparative of bad : more unpleasant, difficult, or severe than before or than something else that is also bad

words.tr: v. “write”的过去分词；写作；书写； adj. 书面的；
words.ex: The letter was written by hand.
words.ex_cn: 这封信是手写的。
words.en: Something that is written has been recorded in writing rather than spoken.

words.ex: He misses his youth when he played football every day.
words.ex_cn: 他怀念每天踢足球的青春时光。
words.en: The period of your life when you are young, or the state of being young.
